verdict.rationale: pnpm docs show per-project pins being enforced for both packages and tools. For packages, CI automatically switches to frozen-lockfile mode and fails if the lockfile needs updating, and catalogs and overrides centralize and force versions. For tools, Node.js can be pinned per project via devEngines.runtime, and pnpm switches to the version declared in packageManager or devEngines.packageManager. missing for 10: an explicit exact-version save option (e.g. save-exact) in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration that pins are respected in practice.
